method: Official docs and primary developer threads opened live; excerpts limited, local gates executed independently.

sources.claim: Validate Origin, bind loopback and authenticate; disconnect is not explicit CancelledNotification.
sources.excerpt: Disconnection SHOULD NOT be interpreted as the client cancelling its request.

sources.claim: Consent and audience boundaries; client token passthrough is forbidden. Preserve separate Fabric binding and product credential.
Node/client requests can omit Origin; test native absence separately from hostile browser Origin. Closed issue is historical symptom, not proof of current SDK behavior.
Signing and notarization are separate steps; release ledger/attestation are separate from native/provider acceptance.
sources.excerpt: the app needs to be code signed

sources.claim: Historical macos-latest failures are diagnosis evidence; do not copy its January2025 runner workaround to October2026 without reproducing exact toolchain.
Protected jobs wait for explicit review; agent cannot substitute local test pass for human release approval.
